text: Proposed specialized AI monitoring services remain a static vision: it is unclear how they would scale computationally or adjust their algorithms as AI agents diversify, which is a critical flaw given the anticipated pervasiveness of those agents.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185

isBasedOn.name: How can we Best Monitor AI Agents

abstract: It is entirely unclear how these specialized AI monitoring services will scale computationally or adjust algorithms as AI agents diversify, a critical flaw given their anticipated pervasiveness.

value: dedicated third party AI monitoring services
